description:
Act your age, whatever you feel that is

Formulated in conjunction with a nutritional scientist for people 55+ our pro-aging multi nutrient health powder is packed with clean lean plant based protein, key vitamins and heart friendly vegan Omega-3 DHA, turmeric extract and is a good source of fibre

Easily Absorbed and Gut Friendly

Efficient and natural absorption into the body plus it’s great for gut health with fibre, prebiotics and turmeric extract.

Plant Based for Optimal Health and Longevity

Plant based protein and algal Omega-3 DHA for heart health derives nutrients direct from the source with longevity benefits.

Convenient and Flexible to your needs

Created to suit your lifestyle this nutrient rich blend can be taken 2-3 times per week, or just when you feel you need a top-up. Simply mixed with water or added to your drink or food

Easy to mix, delicious to drink

BOLD was developed to be easy to mix, so no need for a shaker or blender and has a natural vanilla flavour, so it tastes delicious

 

BOLD Benefits

DHA supports Heart Health

BOLD includes and innovative and nutritious plant based Omega-3 DHA for heart health

Helps develop and Maintain Muscle

Protein is essential for building and repairing muscle tissue. Research has shown that protein intake is positively associated with muscle mass preservation in older adults.

Good source of Vitamins
25% of your recommended daily intake of calcium, magnesium, Vitamin B12, Vitamin D and folate.

Protein for Tissue Repair
The amino acids in protein will help rebuild any torn tissue and in the process, rebuild the muscle fibres back even stronger and bigger

Gut Friendly
Includes fibre, prebiotics and turmeric extract to assist with gut health and inflammation
